title: Facet force at L4-L5 - Popovich JM, Welcher JB, Hedman TP, Tawackoli W, Anand N, Chen TC, Kulig K 2013 (Spine J 13:1581) (secondary, Ghezelbash 2020 review)

quantity.name: facet force
quantity.definition: mean peak facet force +/- SD (pressure-sensitive film)

source.authors: Ghezelbash F, Schmidt H, Shirazi-Adl A, El-Rich M
source.sample: not stated in review (see primary: Popovich JM, Welcher JB, Hedman TP, Tawackoli W, Anand N, Chen TC, Kulig K 2013 (Spine J 13:1581)); human cadaveric lumbar specimens of Popovich JM, Welcher JB, Hedman TP, Tawackoli W, Anand N, Chen TC, Kulig K 2013 (Spine J 13:1581), as compiled in Ghezelbash et al. 2020 Table 2

protocol.summary: Pure moments 10 Nm; axial moment combined with 5 or 10 deg lateral (pelvic obliquity) rotation; mean peak facet force.
how_to_simulate: Apply 10 Nm pure moment in flexion, extension, lateral bending, axial rotation
For combined cases add 5 or 10 deg lateral rotation (pelvic obliquity) to the axial moment
Report peak facet contact force at L4-L5
protocol.notes: Secondary data compiled in a review (Ghezelbash et al.'s review). Sample size, specimen age, rate and cycles are not given in the review; use the primary paper for these. Primary source: Popovich JM, Welcher JB, Hedman TP, Tawackoli W, Anand N, Chen TC, Kulig K 2013 (Spine J 13:1581).

extraction.from: Table 2 (summary of in vitro facet force measurements)
extraction.check_notes: Re-read against the rendered Table 2 image (page 5, 200 dpi): every value, +/-, min/max, units and level labels match the pdftotext output. | 2026-11-12: source.n was the primary paper year (2013); set to n=8 from the primary study in SpineBench.

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 1 SD (mean+/-SD) or min <= model <= max (ranges); widen for facet-force method bias (Wilson 2006)

shared_sample_with: popovich2013: primary (fe_facet tests from Popovich2013.pdf, other fork)
